authSideEffects: Creates up to six temporary sessions (API and direct Supabase per owner), ordinary login audit/rate counters and Auth last-sign-in metadata; closes only those sessions with local scope. No emails or global revocations. No public menu requests or visit metrics from this runner.
persistenceScope: Exact SHA256 before/after for owner-visible restaurant, membership, settings, categories, products, promotions, hours, translations, QR, domains and total; all rows in nine tenant tables; sampled existing private image bytes. Excludes Auth, audit, visits, rate counters and service-only commercial data.
limitations: SELECT/download isolation only; does not exercise blocked INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE or suspended accounts in this run.
One confirmed existing image per tenant is sampled; not an enumeration of all Storage objects.
Successful local checks do not establish Render/public deployment, SMTP, physical QR scanning or device compatibility.
